blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `cancelOrderReturnStep`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

types.name: CancelOrderReturnDTO
types.description: The details of the return cancelation.

children.name: internal_note
children.description: The internal note of the action.

children.name: reference
children.description:
The name of the data model the action
references. For example, `return`.

children.name: reference_id
children.description:
The ID of the record of the data model
specified in [reference](/references/order/interfaces/order.BaseOrderBundledActionsDTO#reference).

For example, if `reference` is `return`, the
value is `return_123`.

children.name: created_by
children.description: The user or customer that created this action.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Holds custom data in key-value pairs.

children.name: canceled_by
children.description: The ID of the user canceling the return.
